description: This file defines the class BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator, which provides a decorator for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity, implementing methods to set related entities and format date/time information related to when a 'like' was made on a shared item in the Buzz feature.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional behaviors and utilities for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity, such as setting related entities and formatting date/time data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzLikeOnShare entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee related to the like using the employee's number.

methods.name: setShareByShareId
methods.description: Sets the BuzzShare entity related to the like using its share ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the like was made, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the like was made, formatted as a string.
